message.content: Based on the discussions among the residents, several types of flowers were suggested for the community garden. According to Turalyon's posts, some of the flowers that were discussed included Bluebells, Camellias, Tulips, and various flowering shrubs such as Hibiscus and Rhododendrons. Additionally, the residents proposed a variety of seating areas, benches, pathways, and even shade structures to enhance the garden's functionality and appeal. There was also a suggestion to incorporate local wildlife-friendly plants to support pollinators like bees and butterflies. These discussions highlight the diverse range of floral choices and amenities residents wish to see in the community garden.
